inputContext.request: Create a small, playable Bubble Break ASMR game for one player on desktop and touch. The player presses individual bubbles on a reusable bubble-wrap sheet. A press visibly depresses and pops that bubble with synchronized satisfying pop audio, then adds exactly one to the popped counter after the pop completes. Holding, spamming, or pressing a popped bubble must not count twice. Let the player finish a sheet of at least twelve bubbles, see completion feedback, and deliberately reset to a fresh sheet. Use a close, readable tabletop presentation and minimal counter/reset UI. Search Marketplace first for a complete reusable interaction, including any existing geometry, animation, sounds and behavior; inspect what it already provides and integrate only missing features. Search separately for missing media if needed. Audio must come from Marketplace and actually play. Record unavailable importer capabilities rather than pretending a suitable scripted component does not exist. Choose reasonable details yourself; no saving, multiplayer, purchases or large map. Success needs observed press/pop/recovery timing, per-bubble state, exact counting, sheet completion/reset and usable desktop/touch input. Do not claim success from code inspection alone.

playerExperience.title: Bubble Break ASMR
playerExperience.summary: A cozy, tactile tabletop Bubble Break ASMR experience designed for both desktop mouse clicks and mobile touch taps. The player spawns facing a clean wooden tabletop featuring a 4x4 bubble wrap sheet (16 translucent pop bubbles). Clicking or tapping an unpopped bubble triggers an immediate visual depression, dynamic material/transparency shift, and a crisp pop audio effect. Once the pop animation finishes, the popped counter increments by exactly one. Popped bubbles lock against re-triggering and spam. Popping all bubbles triggers a satisfying sheet completion banner with celebratory sparkle feedback and activates a tactile 'Reset Sheet' control that smoothly restores all bubbles to their raised state for endless ASMR popping.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Warm, soft-lit tabletop aesthetic. A polished oak desk with subtle bevels rests under a soft warm spotlight against a cozy, minimalist room backdrop. The bubble wrap pad is a sleek matte silicone/plastic tray holding 16 soft rounded domes with glass-like translucency and slight specular highlights. Upon popping, bubbles flatten inwards with a subtle translucent burst ring and turn slightly opaque/crinkled. Clean, modern, distraction-free screen HUD with soft rounded corners, pastel accents, a Popped: X/16 progress pill, and a smooth reset button.

sources.source:
local Button = script.Parent
local ButtonColor = Button.BrickColor
local CanNPCsActivate = script.CanNPCsActivate.Value
local Cooldown = script.Cooldown.Value
local RemovesPreviousModel = script.RemovesPreviousModel.Value
local OffColor = script.OffColor.Value
local Backup = Button.Parent:clone()
Backup:findFirstChild(Button.Name):remove()
Active = true

function Regen()
	if RemovesPreviousModel == true then
		local PreviousModel = Button.Parent:children()
		for i = 1, #PreviousModel do
			if PreviousModel[i] ~= Button then
				PreviousModel[i]:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	local Clone = Backup:clone()
	local Children = Clone:children()
	for i = 1, #Children do
		Children[i].Parent = Button.Parent
		if Children[i]:isA("BasePart") == true or Children[i]:isA("Model") == true then
			Children[i]:makeJoints()
		end
	end
	Clone:Destroy()
end

function Start(Part)
	if Active == true then
		local Humanoid = Part.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid")
		if Humanoid ~= nil then
			if CanNPCsActivate == false then
				Regen()
				Active = false
				Button.BrickColor = OffColor
				wait(Cooldown)
				Active = true
				Button.BrickColor = ButtonColor
			else
				local Plr = game.Players:playerFromCharacter(Part.Parent)
				if Plr ~= nil then
					Regen()
					Active = false
					Button.BrickColor = OffColor
					wait(Cooldown)
					Active = true
					Button.BrickColor = ButtonColor
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
Button.Touched:connect(Start)
